messages:
mia: Noticing a regression after the kernel-affinity tweak rolled last night. Prefill tails jumped on canary, decode path looks unchanged. digging into perf traces now.

sam: Can you drop the numbers, model, and commit?

mia: Canary run (gpt-medium pool, commit 3b9f7d):
```
prefill p50 9ms -> 11ms
prefill p95 28ms -> 62ms
prefill p99 52ms -> 135ms
decode p99 ~130ms (stable)
KV prefill miss rate 11% -> 29%
queue depth (prefill) spike to 150
```
Short profile:
```
[profile] kernel-select: more frequent tiny-kernel picks for prefill, avg 4.8ms, but long queue stalls 20-80ms
[trace] batch-formation loop: prefill windows frequently merged into decode batches -> KV priming gets evicted
[kv-worker] shard-2 eviction churn high, priming reserve low
```
ops-bot: ALERT: prefill-queue-depth > 120 on canary-cluster-7 for 12m

alex: My read: affinity change biased prefill toward smaller kernels (faster single-op but worse KV locality), increasing evictions and miss rate. Two quick mitigations: (A) soft-separate prefill/decode batch windows so prefill gets dedicated micro-windows; (B) enforce a prefill token-budget reserve to keep KV priming within batches.

rachel: Draft canary config (phase_tether v2) to try on 5%:
```
phase_tether_v2:
  enabled: true
  prefill_window_ms: 14     # slightly larger to let prefill batches form
  decode_window_ms: 6
  max_prefill_tokens: 800   # cap to avoid huge prefill dominance
  prefill_priority_bias: 0.2 # favor prefill when stash > threshold
  kv_warmup_reserve_pct: 12 # reserve tokens in batch for priming
  soften_prefill_affinity: true
  fallback: prefer_decode_if_kv_pressure
```
Explain: the aim is not hard partitioning but a soft tethering so kernels and KV priming stay coherent.

ben: Rollout plan: push config + soften_affinity to 5% canary, run 3h mixed synthetic with short prompt heavy traffic and some long-context sessions. Watch these signals: prefill p99, queue depth, kv-miss-rate, kernel switch count/s, and prefill eviction rate. If kv-miss-rate improves and p99 drops, ramp to 25% -> 100%. If not, revert soften_affinity first.

sam: Applying config to canary now. Starting synthetic run. Assigning 3h check to @mia for flamegraphs and a short table of metrics.

mia: ack. I'll post a 3h snapshot with a small flamegraph and a quick diff of kernel selection counts. If we still see prefill spikes, I'll try tightening max_prefill_tokens to 512 and bumping kv_warmup_reserve_pct to 18%.

alex: Also logging an instrumentation tweak: emit per-batch kv-reserve-used and kernel-size-distribution so we can correlate evictions -> kernel choices. lightweight flag: telemetry.prefill.kv_reserve=true

ops-bot: CONFIG APPLIED: phase_tether_v2 to canary-cluster-7 at 6379990450

ben: Thanks. If anyone hits a perf alert while the canary runs, tag #incidents and ping eng-oncall.

mia: posting initial flamegraph in 3h. thanks team :rocket:
